books.title: Roll for Outfit 1, Adventuring Clothes
books.author: Vault of Many Things
books.shortDescription: 221 magical garments and the Ritual of Style, a system for making appearance matter in play.
books.description:
An adventurer's clothes can open doors—or close them before a word is spoken. **Roll for Outfit 1** introduces **221 magical non-armor garments** across six wardrobe categories: Upper Body, Lower Body, Footwear, Hands and Arms, Head and Neck, and Accessories. Each garment features its own magical properties, rarity, value, materials, sizing, and lore.

Beyond the enchanted wardrobe, the book introduces the **Ritual of Style**, a system that makes appearance matter in gameplay. It includes five cleanliness levels, four production quality tiers, eight garment sizes, and rules for environmental wear, maintenance, and repairs. Clothing condition and craftsmanship can influence Charisma checks, social interactions, and market value.

Designed for adventurers and Game Masters, these garments offer new possibilities for exploration, travel, stealth, disguise, and social encounters. Introduce them as magical treasures, merchant wares, or noble gifts, and give players new reasons to consider what their characters wear
books.coverAlt: Roll for Outfit 1, Adventuring Clothes cover featuring an embroidered traveler

books.title: Complete Town 9: Village Chronicles
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: 30 fully developed fantasy villages with maps, memorable NPCs, and four local quests per village.
books.description:
Every village has a story, from the trades that sustain its people to the secrets hidden beneath its traditions. Complete Town 9: Village Chronicles introduces 30 fully developed villages for fantasy roleplaying campaigns, spanning ordinary rural settlements, extraordinary magical communities, and single-ancestry tribal societies. Each village features a unique map, detailed history, economy, culture, government, and local customs, creating living destinations ready to fit into any fantasy world.

Each settlement includes two fully detailed buildings with atmospheric descriptions, read-aloud introductions, events, priced goods and services, and memorable NPCs. Detailed character profiles and four local quests per village provide opportunities for exploration and interaction, while the accompanying artwork brings these communities to life.

Beyond the villages, discover 10 magical heirlooms, a harvest festival with 45 modular scenes, rural encounters, five original creatures, and five escalating natural disasters. A Civil Registry further connects inhabitants and households. Built on 5e mechanics and adaptable to other fantasy TTRPG rulesets, Village Chronicles offers Game Masters a versatile toolkit for turning ordinary settlements into unforgettable adventures.
books.coverAlt: Village Chronicles cover showing a red-roofed village nestled between cliffs

books.title: Complete Town 8: Beyond the Gates
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A two-book toolkit for the roads and wilderness between destinations, with modular encounters, locations, and treasure.
books.description:
The greatest adventures don't always happen in cities or dungeons—sometimes they begin along forgotten roads and unexplored wilderness. **Complete Town 8: Beyond the Gates** is a comprehensive **modular worldbuilding toolkit** designed to fill the spaces between major destinations in fantasy campaigns. Rather than presenting a single settlement, this installment provides an extensive collection of ready-to-use encounters, locations, and narrative situations, organized into two complementary books.

**Book I** introduces a library of thematic categories, each containing unique variations with atmospheric descriptions, adaptable mechanics, artwork, and specialized gameplay elements. From abandoned buildings, dangerous wilderness, and traveling caravans to supernatural phenomena, rituals, and unexpected encounters, these resources help Game Masters bring spontaneous exploration to life.

**Book II** expands the toolkit with **specialized treasure chests**, featuring detailed inventories, traps, and unique mechanics, alongside **an extensive collection of fully developed custom buildings** with NPCs, services, artwork, and encounter tables. A **Civil Registry** provides additional characters and household details to connect these locations into a living world. Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Beyond the Gates transforms ordinary journeys into memorable adventures
books.coverAlt: Beyond the Gates cover showing riders approaching a city in the snowy mountains

books.title: Complete Town 7: Wavespire
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A medieval city with 19 districts and 15 noble houses, built for urban exploration and political intrigue.
books.description:
Between towering mountains and the open sea, a sprawling metropolis thrives on trade, ambition, and political rivalry. **Complete Town 7: Wavespire** introduces a richly developed medieval city of **over 20,000 inhabitants**, divided into **19 distinctive districts** and governed through the shifting influence of **15 noble houses**. From the prestigious halls of Regal Reach to the bustling docks and struggling neighborhoods of Lowtown, every district reveals another side of a city shaped by wealth, class, and power.

Discover **fully detailed key buildings**, each featuring atmospheric descriptions, inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. A **detailed city map featuring numbered buildings** and the accompanying **Civil Registry Ledger** connect residences to their inhabitants, allowing players to explore neighborhoods and discover who lives behind every door. Downloadable artwork provides additional resources for bringing Wavespire to life.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Wavespire offers a living setting for political conspiracies, noble rivalries, criminal intrigue, and urban exploration. Whether serving as a campaign hub or a sprawling city sandbox, Wavespire provides countless opportunities for adventures shaped by its people, districts, and competing ambitions.
books.coverAlt: Wavespire cover showing a sprawling coastal city beneath towering clouds
